name: gizza-ai/geojson-to-svg
summary: Render GeoJSON to an SVG map

tool.description: Render GeoJSON features into a standalone SVG map — no tile servers, no network. Pass `geojson` as a FeatureCollection, a single Feature, or a bare geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon and their Multi/Collection variants); coordinates are [longitude, latitude]. Polygons are filled, lines stroked, points drawn as circles, with holes cut out. Optional `width`, `fill`, `stroke`, `stroke_width`, `point_radius`, `background` ('none' for transparent) and `projection` ('mercator' Web-Mercator or 'none' for raw lon/lat) control the look; everything is scaled to fit the viewport with the aspect ratio preserved. Returns the SVG markup as text. Runs locally on the device.

background.description: Background colour, or 'none'/'transparent' for no background (default #ffffff).

fill.description: Fill colour for polygons, any CSS colour (default #cfe8ff).

geojson.description: GeoJSON to render. Accepts a FeatureCollection, a single Feature, or a bare geometry (Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection). Coordinates are [longitude, latitude].

point_radius.description: Radius in pixels for Point/MultiPoint markers (default 4).

projection.description: Map projection: 'mercator' applies a spherical Web-Mercator transform; 'none' plots raw longitude/latitude (default mercator).

stroke.description: Stroke colour for outlines, lines and point rings (default #1f6feb).

width.description: Output SVG width in pixels; height is derived to preserve aspect ratio (default 800).
